commands.name: template-parses-and-rm-ask-rule-gone
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; p=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))['permissions']; sys.exit(0 if 'Bash(rm:*)' not in p['ask'] and 'Bash(rm:*)' not in p['allow'] and p['defaultMode']=='auto' else 1)"

commands.name: template-ask-rules-exact
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; p=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))['permissions']; sys.exit(0 if p['ask']==['Bash(git push --force:*)','Bash(git push -f:*)','Bash(git push --force-with-lease:*)','Bash(git push --mirror:*)','mcp__plugin_atlassian_atlassian__createJiraIssue'] else 1)"

commands.name: template-deny-floor-exact
commands.run: python3 -c "import json,sys; p=json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))['permissions']; t=['/','~','~/','\$HOME','\$HOME/','\"\$HOME\"','\"\$HOME/\"','\${HOME}','\${HOME}/','.git','.git/','./.git','./.git/']; want=[r for x in t for r in ('Bash(rm * %s)'%x,'Bash(rm * %s *)'%x)]; sys.exit(0 if p['deny']==want else 1)"

commands.name: template-rule-model-harmless-and-prohibited
commands.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re, sys
p = json.load(open('claude/settings.json.tmpl'))['permissions']
def m(rule, cmd):
    pat = rule[len('Bash('):-1]
    if pat.endswith(':*'):
        pat = pat[:-2] + ' *'
    if pat.endswith(' *') and pat.count('*') == 1:
        rx = '^' + re.escape(pat[:-2]) + '( .*)?$'
    else:
        rx = '^' + '.*'.join(re.escape(x) for x in pat.split('*')) + '$'
    return re.match(rx, cmd, re.DOTALL) is not None
bash_rules = [r for r in p['deny'] + p['ask'] if r.startswith('Bash(')]
harmless = ['rm -f /tmp/scratch.txt', 'rm -rf /tmp/co-review-snap.x', 'rm -rf .git/index.lock', 'rm -rf build', 'rm -rf ~/proj/build', 'rm -rf $HOME/.cache/x', 'rm .gitignore', 'rm -rf ./.github']
prohibited = ['rm -rf /', 'rm -r -f ~', 'rm -rf "$HOME"', 'rm -rf ${HOME}', 'rm -rf .git', 'rm -rf ./.git/', 'rm -rf / --no-preserve-root', 'rm --recursive --force ~/', 'rm -rf ${HOME}/', 'rm -f ~']
bad = [c for c in harmless if any(m(r, c) for r in bash_rules)]
bad += [c for c in prohibited if not any(m(r, c) for r in p['deny'])]
print('rule-model failures:', bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PY
